english_text: Settle me in the House of rest (Paradise),

arabic_text: وَ اغْفِرْ لي وَ لِجَميعِ إخْواني فيكَ وَ أخَواتِيَ الْمُؤْمِنينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِناتِ،
transliteration: waghfir lī wa lijamīi 'ikhwāni fīka wa 'akhawātiyal mu'minīna wal mu'mināt,
english_text: And forgive me and all my faithful brothers and sisters,
By Your mercy, O the most merciful of the merciful!
There is no deity but Allah, the forbearing, the generous.
There is no deity but Allah, the supreme, the great.

arabic_text: لاإلهَ إلاَّاللهُ رَبُّ السَّماواتِ السَّبْعِ وَ الأرَضينَ السَّبْعِ،
english_text: There is no deity but Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens and the seven earths,

arabic_text: وَ ما فيهِنَّ وَ ما بَيْنَهُنَّ،
transliteration: wa mā fīhinna wa mā baynahunn,
english_text: and whatever is in them and whatever is between them.
(By this, I am) opposing (the belief of) His enemies,
disavowing whomever has turned away from Him,
confessing His Lordship,
and surrendering to His majesty.
He is the first other than being the first (in number).
He is the last without having an end.
He is dominant (Zahir) over everything by His power.

arabic_text: الْباطِنُ دُونَ كُلِّ شَىْء بِعِلْمِهِ وَ لُطْفِهِ،
transliteration: al-bāţinu dūna kulli shay'in biilmihi wa luţfih,
english_text: He is hidden (Batin) as He knows underneath of every thing by His knowledge and His subtlety.

arabic_text: لا تَقِفُ الْعُقُولُ عَلى كُنْهِ عَظَمَتِهِ،
transliteration: lā taqiful uqūlu alā kunhi ađamatih,
english_text: Intellects cannot comprehend the depth of His grandeur.

arabic_text: وَ لا تُدْرِكُ الأوْهامُ حَقيقَةَ ماهِيَّتِهِ،
english_text: Thoughts cannot grasp the reality of His Essence.

arabic_text: وَ لا تَتَصَوَّرُ الأنْفُسُ مَعانِيَ كَيْفِيَّتِهِ،
english_text: Souls cannot imagine the meanings of His (created) qualities.
He knows well the innermost thoughts (of His servants),
is cognizant of the secrets,

arabic_text: يَعْلَمُ خائِنَةَ الأعْيُنِ وَ ما تُخْفِى الصُّدُورُ،
english_text: and knows the treachery of the eyes, and all that the hearts (of men) conceal.[1]

arabic_text: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي اُشْهِدُكَ عَلى تَصْديقي رَسُولَكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ إيماني بِهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma 'innī 'ush-hiduka alā tašdīqī rasūlaka šallal-lāhu layhi wa ālih wa 'īmānī bih,
english_text: My Allah! I bear You as witness of my acknowledgement of Your Messenger (PBUH&HF) and my faith in him,
and my recognition of his status.

arabic_text: وَ إنّي أشْهَدُ أنَّهُ النَّبِيُّ الَّذي نَطَقَتِ الْحِكْمَةُ بِفَضْلِهِ،
english_text: I bear witness that he was the Prophet by whose favor wisdom was given voice,
of whom (previous) prophets gave glad tidings,

arabic_text: وَ دَعَتْ إلَى الإقْرارِ بِما جاءَ بِهِ،
english_text: called people to admit what he brought (from the Lord),
and urged people to acknowledge him,

arabic_text: بِقَوْلِهِ تَعالى: «اَلَّذي يَجِدُونَهُ مَكْتُوباً عِنْدَهُمْ فِي التَّوْريةِ وَ الإنْجيلِ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ يَنْهيهُمْ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ يُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّباتِ وَ يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبائِثَ وَ يَضَعُ عَنْهُمْ إصْرَهُمْ وَ الأغْلالَ الَّتي كانَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ»،
transliteration: biqawlihi ta'ālā: alladhīna yajidūnahu maktūban indahum fit-tawrāti wal 'injīli ya'muruhum bil marūfi wa yanhāhum anil munkari wa yuħillu lahumuţ-ţayyibāti wa yuħarrimu alayhimul khabā'itha wa yađhau anhum 'išrahum wal 'aghlālal-lati kānat
english_text: according to His saying, the most high, “… he, whom they find mentioned in their Torah and the Gospels, who commands them virtuous acts and forbids them evil, allows them as lawful the good (and pure) things, prohibits them from impurities, and releases them from their heavy burdens and from the yokes that are upon them ...” [2]

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِكَ إلَى الثَّقَلَيْنِ،
english_text: Thus, bless Muhammad, Your messenger to both masses (of human and Jinn),
the master of the chosen prophets,
